left_out.label: 995-guard
left_out.part: the negative-slot guard in copy_alloc and copy_apply (tilelang_copy.py) and its canary test, as reworked in round 3
left_out.reason: does nothing on this deployment: its rework's caller trace shows that no serving path passes a negative slot to copy_alloc or copy_apply (both get input_batch.idx_mapping, real slots from RequestState; only copy_match receives -1 rows, and it already guards slot >= 0). So it guards a path nothing takes, and under step 1's deployment-only rule it does not belong in a candidate. The rework is bit-exact and costs nothing measurable at the copy-step bench (about 40 ns of device time a step at kernel level)
left_out.disposition: left out at assembly (coordinator, 2026-11-10); the rework's deliverables are kept
